notes.text:
This update for go1.24-openssl fixes the following issues:

Update to version 1.24.4 (bsc#1236217):

- CVE-2025-22874 crypto/x509: ExtKeyUsageAny bypasses policy validation (bsc#1244158).
- CVE-2025-0913 os: inconsistent handling of O_CREATE|O_EXCL on Unix and Windows (bsc#1244157).
- CVE-2025-4673 net/http: sensitive headers not cleared on cross-origin redirect (bsc#1244156).

notes.text: os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|O_EXCL) behaved differently on Unix and Windows systems when the target path was a dangling symlink. On Unix systems, OpenFile with O_CREATE and O_EXCL flags never follows symlinks. On Windows, when the target path was a symlink to a nonexistent location, OpenFile would create a file in that location. OpenFile now always returns an error when the O_CREATE and O_EXCL flags are both set and the target path is a symlink.
